checked_precondition_contracts.description: Every participating integer divisor lane is nonzero; inactive masked lanes and floating-point lanes are excluded.
checked_precondition_contracts.unchecked_consequence: Violating this precondition may cause undefined behavior, a hardware trap, or process termination.

checked_precondition_contracts.description: The compacted memory operand represents at least one element for every active mask lane.
checked_precondition_contracts.unchecked_consequence: Violating this precondition may read or write outside the live memory object, causing undefined behavior or a process-level fault.

checked_precondition_contracts.description: The contiguous memory operand represents at least the operation's complete scalar or vector payload extent.
checked_precondition_contracts.unchecked_consequence: Violating this precondition may read or write outside the live memory object, causing undefined behavior or a process-level fault.

checked_precondition_contracts.description: The index-vector lane extent satisfies the indexed memory contract, and every active accessed index with its compile-time byte scale forms an aligned element address wholly inside the represented base range without overflowing address arithmetic.
checked_precondition_contracts.unchecked_consequence: Violating this precondition may form or access an invalid pointer, causing undefined behavior or a process-level fault.

checked_precondition_contracts.description: The runtime lane index is smaller than the logical lane count.
checked_precondition_contracts.unchecked_consequence: Violating this precondition may cause undefined behavior or a process-terminating memory access.

checked_precondition_contracts.description: When aligned access is selected and the operation accesses at least one element, the memory operand satisfies the payload's required alignment.
checked_precondition_contracts.unchecked_consequence: Violating this precondition may cause undefined behavior, a hardware fault, or a process-level trap.
